data.name: Surging Blood
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis

Fast-FPS with retro PS1 aesthetics, blending steampunk and Victorian gothic.

You play as Viktor von Faust, a war veteran sent by the Queen to investigate Cinderval, a once-thriving mining town now completely cut off from the world. What should have been a simple reconnaissance mission quickly turns into a nightmare in a place plagued by forbidden experiments, twisted ideologies, and science that has surpassed all moral boundaries.

The game offers an experience combining fast-paced action, exploration, and environmental storytelling in an oppressive world.

Key features

  • Fast-paced and brutal FPS

    Fight with steampunk-inspired firearms in fast and direct gameplay, faithful to the shooters of the 90s.

  • Alchemical powers

    Manipulate supernatural abilities derived from alchemy and transhumanism: enhance your body, alter matter, and gain the upper hand over your enemies.

  • Steampunk & Victorian Gothic universe

    Explore a dark mining village made of gears, smoke, mechanics, and degenerate machines, and more... Strong, environmental storytelling Discover the story of Cinderval through exploration, scenery, documents, and dialogue, without ever breaking the rhythm of the game.

  • Dark and oppressive atmosphere

    A deliberately retro art style, disturbing lighting, and a heavy soundscape reinforce the feeling of constant danger.

  • Retro PS1 aesthetic

    Low-poly graphics, grainy textures, and deliberate visual limitations for a nostalgic and stylized immersion.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
